description:
You have coins of several denominations in the array `coins` and an integer `amount`. Return the **fewest coins** needed to make up exactly `amount`, or `-1` if it cannot be done.

You have an unlimited supply of each denomination.
hints: Let best[a] be the fewest coins for amount a. Then best[a] = 1 + min(best[a - c]) over every coin c.
Fill the table from 0 up to amount.
